title: The Legacy of the Transcender
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to grasp that ultimate truth, the Tianji Record suddenly burned hot—that will that had slumbered for ten thousand years seemed to have finally noticed this intruder.

text.content: At the moment the voice shattered into fragments, Chen Ji lunged forward, his five fingers hooked like talons reaching into the void, as if trying to grasp the dissipating will in his palm. His fingertips only touched cold emptiness—as if clutching snow that was melting away. "Escaped again." He chuckled lowly, but there was no笑意 in his eyes. The existence capable of setting a puppet right under the Tianji Record's nose, and self-destructing at the final moment, was no ordinary character. In the darkness, the puppet that had lost its will collapsed with a deafening metallic crash against the stone floor. Chen Ji crouched down, his gaze sweeping over the puppet remains like a hawk. The bronze-cast body was covered in dense, ancient runes never seen before, glowing with an eerie azure hue under the moonlight. "Interesting." He extended his index finger, gently brushing across those runes—the touch was biting cold, carrying a faint sting, like needles—like the aura of heavenly laws, yet subtly different from the current Heavenly Dao, more... primordial, more savage.

Just then, the stone slab beneath his feet blazed with blinding light. Countless runes surged like a tide from all directions,汇聚成一个巨大的阵法图腾。 At the center of the formation, an ancient concave slot slowly emerged, its shape... unmistakably matching the outline of the Tianji Record Fragment. "Requires the Tianji Record as a key?" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a playful arc curling his lips. Who was the designer of this mechanism? Why were they so certain that someone bearing the Tianji Record would appear here? Countless questions surged through his mind, but he didn't hesitate long. He retrieved the fragment from his chest and gently fitted it into the slot—a perfect match. In an instant, an earth-shattering tremor rose from deep underground, and the rock wall ahead rippled like water, revealing a descending staircase passage. From the depths of the passage came light.

The staircase stretched long, as if leading to the deepest part of the earth. Chen Ji's footsteps echoed in the silence, each step pressing down on the dust of ten thousand years. After roughly half an hour, that light finally drew near—a vast stone chamber, its walls inlaid with unknown luminous crystals, illuminating the room bright as day. At the chamber's center stood a proud stone platform, and on the platform... sat a pile of withered bones. The skeleton maintained a meditative posture, its frame broad, and even after ten thousand years, one could still sense the威严 of its former owner. Most bizarrely, embedded in the skull's brow center was a shattered turtle shell—the patterns on it matched the runes on the Tianji Record precisely. "Making a show of mystery." Chen Ji scanned his surroundings, confirming no danger before slowly approaching the platform. On the ground before the skeleton were carved large ancient seal characters: "I am the twenty-seventh generation holder of the Tianji Record, descendants call me—the Transcender."

dialogue.content: "Twenty-seventh generation..." Chen Ji softly repeated this number, his fingertips gently tapping the edge of the platform. The Tianji Record's lineage to the present, if he remembered correctly, had reached the thirty-second generation. Which meant this skeleton preceded him by five full generations. He knew better than anyone how vast the span between five generations of Tianji Record holders truly was. "What do you want to tell me?" he asked, his voice reverberating through the spacious chamber. Silence. Prolonged silence. Just as Chen Ji assumed there would be no response, that turtle shell suddenly blazed with light, and a illusory figure slowly rose from the skeleton—an middle-aged man's face, with sword-like brows and star-bright eyes, bearing an immortal demeanor, yet his eyes held inseparable exhaustion and unwillingness. "You have finally come." The phantom spoke, its voice aged and hoarse, "I waited so long... long enough that I nearly forgot what I was waiting for."

text.content: Chen Ji neither retreated nor showed any panic. He simply watched that phantom silently, his gaze deep as an abyss. "You deliberately set up the puppet to lure me here?" The phantom gave a bitter smile, that smile carrying too much unspeakable vicissitude. "The puppet? That was my obsession made manifest. When I fell ten thousand years ago, I sealed my final strand of will within it, solely to wait for someone... capable of hearing my voice." Chen Ji coldly laughed: "Why me?" The phantom raised its eyes, those虚幻眼眸 seeming capable of seeing through the depths of Chen Ji's soul. "Because you are the first... who, after sensing my puppet, did not choose to flee, but chose to investigate the truth." The phantom paused, continuing, "Ten thousand years have passed. Too many successors of the Tianji Record have passed this place, yet none were willing to go deeper. They only wished to exploit the Tianji Record's power for power and status, never once considering... the true origins of the Tianji Record, never questioning the truth behind the Heavenly Dao."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's heart sank violently. "The truth behind the Heavenly Dao"—these words were like a blunt blade, hacking狠狠地 at the softest part of his heart. The Eye of Heavenly Providence. That ultimate existence that would only surface in volume eight, yet now was being vaguely触及 from the mouth of a ten-thousand-year-old skeleton. "What do you know?" His voice unconsciously lowered, carrying aurgency he himself had not noticed. The phantom seemed very satisfied with his reaction, its lips slightly raised. "I know far more than you imagine. For instance... the Tianji Record is no divine object, but a 'shackle'亲手forged by the Heavenly Dao's will in ancient times. Every holder believes they can foresee the future and control destiny, not knowing... we are merely the most obedient pieces on the Heavenly Dao's chessboard." The phantom's tone suddenly turned cold and sinister, "It shows us what it wants us to see, makes us think we are maneuvering the world, when in truth... all our actions are within its calculations."

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long time. So long that the phantom began trembling slightly, as if it might dissipate at any moment. "Since you knew all this, why didn't you speak up sooner?" His voice was very calm, almost coldly so. "What would speaking up accomplish?" The phantom bitterly laughed, "Every generation of Tianji Record holders meets the same fate—swallowed by the Eye of Heavenly Providence, becoming part of its power. I tried to resist, tried to break this chess game, I even... found a method that might succeed." The phantom's eyes suddenly blazed, carrying a近乎癫狂的light, "But I failed. My failure cost me ten thousand years. And now, I pass this method... to you." The phantom raised its虚幻 hand, pointing to its own brow center—that turtle shell. "The secrets of the Tianji Record lie within. But before that, you need to make a choice—"

choice.prompt: The phantom's eyes flickered with azure light,似乎在等待陈机的答复。 The Transcender's path requires completely abandoning the Tianji Record's power, opposing the Heavenly Dao with pure will; while carving a new path means seeking breakthrough based on the Tianji Record, with risks and opportunities coexisting.

choices.description: Abandon the Tianji Record's power, walking a path不被天道左右的道路。 This road is solitary and dangerous, yet the purest.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Transcender's Legacy Will Cultivation Method
choices.risk_hint: After losing the Tianji Record, you will no longer be able to foresee three hours ahead, all plans must start anew
choices.process_label: 你选择了一条最难的路

text.content: Upon hearing this, the phantom's eyes flashed with relief, yet夹杂着难以掩饰的悲凉。 "Good... good!" His voice began to tremble, "Ten thousand years, finally someone is willing... willing to let go of this damn key!" He suddenly raised his hand, and that turtle shell flew out from the skeleton, directly crashing into Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power flood into his mind—not the Tianji Record's foresight ability, but something more primordial, more violent. Pure will. Power unconstrained by any law, belonging to cultivators' most fundamental nature. "Remember," the phantom's form began to rapidly dissipate, "the Eye of Heavenly Providence's greatest weakness is that it..."

choices.description: Seek breakthroughs based on the Tianji Record, neither blindly accepting the Transcender's legacy nor easily abandoning existing advantages. This path is the most stable, yet also the most arduous.
choices.visible_cost: Need to bear more unknown risks
choices.visible_reward: Retain the Tianji Record's abilities while gaining the Transcender's research notes
choices.risk_hint: The Transcender's methods may conflict with your philosophy,强行融合存在隐患

text.content: The phantom's eyes flashed with surprise, then transformed into admiration. "Not following my old path, nor abandoning existing advantages... clever calculations." His voice carried a bitter laugh, "Had I been this steady ten thousand years ago, perhaps... never mind, let bygones be bygones." He raised his hand and waved. That turtle shell did not fly toward Chen Ji, but slowly cracked open, revealing within a thin as cicada's wing silk brocade. "This is the crystallization of my lifelong research—the operating patterns of the Eye of Heavenly Providence, and... its possible flaws." The silk brocade gently floated into Chen Ji's hand. Upon unfolding it, he saw it densely filled with ancient characters and diagrams. "As for the breakthrough you seek..." the phantom's form had begun to dissipate, but its voice grew clearer, "is on the last page of that silk brocade. The method I didn't dare try, perhaps... you can accomplish it."

The moment the phantom completely dissipated, the stone chamber fell into deathly silence. Chen Ji stood alone before the skeleton, the silk brocade in his hand or enduring the burning sensation remaining at his brow center, silent for a long while. "The twenty-seventh generation from ten thousand years ago..." he murmured to himself, his gaze falling on that skeleton. This existence that had once controlled the Tianji Record, researching methods to oppose the Heavenly Dao alone through the long years, ultimately meeting an end of body and Dao destroyed. "Does your failure foreshadow my outcome?" Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery, "No... your failure was because you were too impatient. You wanted to reach the sky in one step, so you撞得头破血流。" He turned, his gaze sweeping across the chamber's four walls—the luminous crystals, the ancient runes, the traces eroded by time, all were the Transcender's legacy. "But I am different." Chen Ji slowly walked deeper into the chamber, where there was a small door he hadn't noticed before. "I have patience... and time."

dialogue.content: Pushing open that small door, a musty odor rushed to meet him. This was the Transcender's study—though simple, it was堆满了竹简、jade slips, silk brocades, and various materials of unknown names. Chen Ji casually picked up a bamboo slip, densely carved with small characters: "Day one thousand three hundred and twenty-seven... attempted to use the Tianji Record to trace backwards the source of the Eye of Heavenly Providence, failed, Heavenly Fate Value dropped thirty..." "Day one thousand five hundred and ninety-two... discovered an interesting phenomenon, the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Providence seems to have... gaps? If one could seize that gap, perhaps..." The following characters were erased by some force, leaving only blanks. Chen Ji furrowed his brows, placing the slip back. The materials in this study were vast as the ocean, impossible to finish reading even in a lifetime. He had to make a choice.

text.content: Deep within the stone chamber, a massive stone tablet stood motionless. Its surface smooth as a mirror, yet not reflective, seeming capable of devouring all light. Chen Ji approached, extending his finger to gently touch it—a biting cold traveled through his fingertips, and simultaneously, countless images exploded in his mind. Those were... scenes from ten thousand years ago. The first scene where the Eye of Heavenly Providence manifested. Countless Tianji Record holders going forward courageously, one by one falling. And also... the final scene the Transcender saw before death. Chen Ji猛地收回手, gasping for breath, cold sweat已经浸透了后背。 "Is this... the truth of the Tianji Record?" he murmured, his voice hoarse and almost out of tune. In his mind, those支离破碎的画面 continued to flash. He saw—the Eye of Heavenly Providence was not a person or a life form, but a... rule. A rule transcending all living beings, eternally operating. The so-called "transcendence" is...

choice.prompt: The information from the stone tablet still echoed in Chen Ji's mind—he needed to decide how to handle it. Should he immediately delve deeper into the research, or temporarily seal it away?

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, immediately attempt to decipher the deeper information contained within the stone tablet. High risk, high reward—potentially achieve a critical breakthrough.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value consumed: additional 15 points
choices.visible_reward: Unlock elementary understanding of Heavenly Eye's operational rules
choices.risk_hint: Forced interpretation may cause damage to spiritual consciousness, and could alert Heavenly Eye's attention

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, pressing both palms against the stone tablet's surface. He could feel his Heavenly Fate Value rapidly draining away—ten points, twenty points, thirty points... But at the same time, countless bizarre information flooded into his mind like a tide. The operational rules of Heavenly Eye became clearer than ever before. It was not omniscient; its power came from... the faith of all beings? No, more precisely, it came from the recognition of all life toward 'fate'. Every person who believed in fate, who surrendered to fate, was unconsciously transmitting power to Heavenly Eye. 'So that's how it is...' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips, 'It's not invincible—it's just... a parasite.'

choices.description: The information is too vast. Studying it now might lead to indigestion. Better to seal it first and interpret it deeply after adequate preparation.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the complete memory of the stone tablet, can be triggered again at any time
choices.risk_hint: Sealed information may gradually become blurred over time

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his hands and took a deep breath. Those images, those pieces of information—though merely a fleeting glimpse—had already left a profound imprint in his mind. He closed his eyes, sealing those fragments deep into his memory, waiting to digest them slowly in the future. 'The legacy of the Transcender, plus my own schemes...' He opened his eyes, his gaze flickering with dangerous light, 'This chess game will last me a long time.' The moment he turned away from the stone tablet, Chen Ji suddenly sensed a faint vibration from the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace—as if something was watching him from afar.

The sky outside the stone chamber had already begun to glow with the first light of dawn. Chen Ji didn't know how long he had stayed in that ruins, but one thing was certain—at least three days had passed in the outside world. Three days—enough for many things to happen. He straightened his clothes, confirmed nothing was left behind, and slowly walked toward the exit. In his embrace, the silk and bamboo slips left by the Transcender lay quietly, as if sleeping. Chen Ji was not in a hurry to open them. Some things need the most opportune moment to exert their greatest value. 'Heavenly Eye...' he murmured, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his lips, 'So you are not that formidable after all.' The moment he stepped out of the ruins, the first rays of morning sunlight fell on his face, warm yet dazzling. Chen Ji slightly narrowed his eyes, taking a deep breath of fresh air. This game had only just begun.

choice.prompt: After leaving the ruins, Chen Ji faced a new choice—the situation at Tianqing Sect was unknown, and he needed to decide his next course of action.

choices.description: Three days of absence, Tianqing Sect must have descended into chaos. Was Su Qingyao still investigating him? Had Senior Ling Yuan taken any actions? Let's go back and see the situation.
choices.visible_reward: Reassert control over sect situation, proactively respond to potential threats
choices.risk_hint: Three days of absence will inevitably arouse suspicion, need to prepare a reasonable explanation

text.content: After flying against the wind for about two hours, the mountain gate of Tianqing Sect finally appeared in Chen Ji's field of vision. From afar, he could see figures bustling at the mountain gate, as if something was happening. He slowed down, stealthily landing in a concealed mountain hollow, concealing his aura, and quietly observed. At the mountain gate, a young man dressed in Xuanwu Sect attire was confronting the Tianqing Sect guards. The man was tall and powerfully built, his face cold and stern, radiating a pressuring aura—all hallmarks of Han Lie, the number one genius of Xuanwu Sect. In his hand, he held a blood-soaked cloth bundle. 'Hand over Chen Ji,' Han Lie's voice was ice-cold and piercing, 'or today will be the end of Tianqing Sect.' Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a playful smile curling at the corner of his lips. The show had begun.

choices.description: There seemed to be no news from Ye Qing for a long time. The movements of the Demonic Path Holy Sect were unclear. Perhaps now was an opportunity to investigate and gather intelligence for future arrangements.
choices.visible_reward: Gain important intelligence on the Demonic Path's internal affairs
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Territory is fraught with dangers; exposing one's identity would have unthinkable consequences.

text.content: Chen Ji changed direction and flew toward the Demonic Path Territory. Along the way, he carefully suppressed his aura, using the faint perception of the Tianji Record to evade any possible detection. Three days later, he found the cipher Ye Qing had left in a secluded valley—a jade pendant carved with a black mandala. Following the cipher's guidance, he arrived at a hidden underground palace. Deep within the palace, Ye Qing sat cross-legged in the center of the Blood Pool, surrounded by eerie black mist. Her aura, stronger than their last meeting by more than double, yet also far more... unstable. "You've come." Ye Qing opened her eyes; those once charming and enchanting pupils now flickered with an uncanny crimson glow. "I thought... you'd forgotten me."

Just as Chen Ji was about to touch that ultimate truth, the Tianji Record suddenly burned hot—that will dormant for ten thousand years seemed to have finally noticed this intruder. An invisible pressure descended from above, as if a pair of unseen eyes were piercing through the countless voids, staring fixedly at him. That was... the Gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye! Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, a chill rising from his tailbone straight to his fontanelle. The Transcender's warning from ten thousand years echoed in his mind: "The greatest weakness of the Heavenly Dao's Eye is that it..." What was that weakness? The sentence the Transcender failed to finish now lodged like a thorn, ruthlessly piercing Chen Ji's heart. He knew he had been marked, yet he also understood—this might be the opportunity for breakthrough. The chess game had been set, the opponent had made their move. And he, Chen Ji, a disciple once deemed worthless by all, was about to overturn the entire board in this millennia-spanning game of strategy.
